recommendation: A strong agency-side digital leadership mandate combining integrated client counsel, capability building, commercial performance and team leadership, with a close fit to your agency, automotive, digital transformation and P&L record.
whyNow: Weber Shandwick is explicitly repositioning digital from a specialist capability to a central client and business-growth platform in Mumbai.
primaryDriver: Build and grow an integrated digital communications practice that combines strategy, creativity, technology and commercial ownership.
primaryRisk: The role is communications-led rather than pure performance marketing, so the strongest case must connect integrated agency leadership to earned, owned, paid, influencer and content work without overstating PR-specialist depth.
hiringRisk: How much of the role's revenue and profitability accountability is direct practice P&L ownership, and how heavily is deep earned-communications expertise weighted?
positioning: Your agency leadership, integrated client mandates, digital capability building and commercial accountability map directly to the practice-building brief.
Your record should be framed around integrated client and business growth rather than narrowly around performance marketing.

requirements.requirement: 10+ years in digital communications, digital marketing or integrated communications within an agency
requirements.reasoning: The candidate has more than 20 years across agency and client-side marketing, including senior WPP/VML leadership.

requirements.requirement: Integrated digital strategy across social, content, influencer, paid and analytics
requirements.reasoning: The record includes integrated digital, performance, analytics and multi-channel client mandates.

requirements.requirement: Lead integrated client mandates across communications, creative, media and strategy teams
requirements.reasoning: The candidate has led integrated mainline, digital, PR and performance mandates in agency environments.

requirements.requirement: Grow client relationships and support new business
requirements.reasoning: Commercial account growth, strategic pitches and large fee-book accountability are documented.

requirements.requirement: Own commercial practice performance including forecasting, resourcing and profitability
requirements.reasoning: The candidate has P&L and profitability accountability, including an $8M agency fee book.

requirements.requirement: Build, mentor and lead high-performing teams
requirements.reasoning: The candidate has built and led a 40-member regional centre of excellence.

mandatePriorities: Lead Weber Shandwick's digital practice in Mumbai as both a standalone and integrated capability.
Develop integrated digital strategies across earned, owned, paid, influencer and content.
Grow client relationships and digital-led new business while acting as senior strategic counsel.
Evolve the practice through emerging platforms, technology and AI.
Own commercial performance, forecasting, resourcing, profitability and delivery quality.
mandateOutcomes: Grow a commercially successful, integrated digital practice with stronger client impact, capability depth and team performance.
openQuestions: What revenue and profitability target does the Mumbai digital practice own?
How much specialist earned-communications depth is expected from the VP personally versus the wider team?
executiveThesis: This is an integrated digital practice leadership role: the candidate must combine senior client counsel, capability building, commercial ownership and multidisciplinary delivery.
